description: "The Boy in the Bush" by Richard Rowe is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story unfolds in the Australian bush and centers around the Lawson family, particularly the young boy, Sydney Lawson, as he navigates life on their cattle station during a time fraught with challenges such as bushrangers and natural adversities.
